markets.rules_primary: If the maximum temperature recorded at Phoenix for Jul 13, 2026, is greater than 112° fahrenheit according to the National Weather Service's Climatological Report (Daily), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:

Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the corresponding NWS Climatological Report (Daily) linked in the rules above.
